en: In November 2025,
Microsoft's CEO said something strange.
zh: 微软的 CEO 说了一句奇怪的话。

en: His company may have a bunch of AI chips
zh: 他们可能有一大批 AI 芯片躺在库存里，

en: sitting in inventory — that it can't plug in.
zh: 插不上电。

en: The chips weren't the problem.
zh: 问题不在芯片。

en: The problem, in his words, was power.
zh: 用他的话说，问题在电。

en: So here's the question:
zh: 所以问题来了：电，

en: will electricity become the ceiling on AI?
zh: 会不会成为 AI 的天花板？

en: My answer is yes. But not in the way you think.
zh: 我的答案是：会。但不是你想的那种方式。

en: Because the thing that's really running
zh: 因为真正不够用的，

en: out might not be electricity at all.
zh: 可能根本不是电。

en: First, why does AI need
zh: 先说说，

en: so much electricity in the first place?
zh: AI 到底为什么这么耗电？

en: Data centers are built from racks,
zh: 数据中心是由一个个机柜组成的，

en: tall cabinets packed with computers.
zh: 就是塞满电脑的高柜子。

en: In 2024, the average rack drew under 8 kilowatts.
zh: 2024 年，一个机柜平均用电不到 8 千瓦。

en: A single rack of Nvidia's GB200 AI
zh: 而英伟达 GB200 AI 系统的一个机柜，

en: system is estimated to draw around 120.
zh: 估计要用大约 120 千瓦。

en: That's roughly fifteen times as much, in one cabinet.
zh: 一个柜子，差不多是普通机柜的 15 倍。

en: Now fill a whole campus with them.
zh: 现在把整个园区都装满这种机柜。

en: Elon Musk's xAI already runs about one and a half gigawatts
zh: 马斯克的 xAI，

en: of its own power plants for its data centers in Memphis.
zh: 光在孟菲斯就为自己的数据中心配了大约 1.5 吉瓦的自建电站。

en: One gigawatt, running around the clock,
zh: 1 吉瓦全天候运转，

en: is about what 800,000 average American homes use.
zh: 大约相当于 80 万户美国普通家庭的用电量。

en: Add it all up, and in 2024, data centers worldwide
zh: 全部加起来，

en: used about 415 terawatt-hours of electricity.
zh: 2024 年全球数据中心用了大约 415 太瓦时的电。

en: That's around one and a half percent
zh: 大约占全世界用电

en: of all the electricity the world uses.
One and a half percent doesn't sound like a crisis.
zh: 1.5%，听起来不像什么危机。

en: But the International Energy Agency expects
zh: 但国际能源署预计，

en: it to more than double by 2030, to around 945 terawatt-hours.
zh: 到 2030 年这个数字会翻一倍多，达到约 945 太瓦时。

en: That's slightly more than all of Japan uses today.
zh: 比整个日本今天的用电量还略多一点。

en: And it's concentrated. The United States alone accounts
zh: 而且非常集中。光美国一家，

en: for about 45 percent of data center electricity.
zh: 就占了全球数据中心用电的约 45%。

en: Through 2030, data centers are expected to drive
zh: 到 2030 年，美国新增的用电需求里，

en: nearly half of America's growth in electricity demand.
zh: 预计将近一半来自数据中心。

en: You might think: chips keep getting more efficient.
zh: 你可能会想：芯片越来越省电，

en: Won't that solve it?
zh: 问题不就解决了吗？

en: They are getting more efficient.
zh: 芯片确实越来越省电。

en: Nvidia says its newest system delivers up to 25
zh: 英伟达说，在某些 AI 任务上，

en: times more performance at the same power
zh: 它最新的系统在同样的用电下，

en: than the previous generation, on certain AI tasks.
zh: 性能最高是上一代的 25 倍。

en: And yet, data center electricity use
zh: 但从 2017 年到现在，

en: has grown about 12 percent a year since 2017,
zh: 数据中心的用电量每年增长约 12%，

en: more than four times faster than electricity use overall.
zh: 是全社会用电增速的四倍多。

en: This is an old story. In 1865, the economist
zh: 这是个老故事了。1865 年，

en: William Stanley Jevons noticed that more efficient steam
zh: 经济学家杰文斯发现：更高效的蒸汽机并没有让英国少烧煤，

en: engines didn't cut Britain's coal use. They increased it.
zh: 反而让英国烧得更多了。

en: When something gets cheaper to use,
zh: 一样东西用起来越便宜，

en: we find far more ways to use it.
zh: 我们就会找到越多的用法。

en: Cheaper AI means more AI.
zh: AI 越便宜，

en: Efficiency doesn't shrink the bill. It grows the appetite.
zh: 用的人就越多。效率不会让账单变小，只会让胃口变大。

en: Here's what most people miss.
zh: 但大多数人没注意到这一点。

en: The world isn't running out of electricity.
zh: 世界不是电不够了，

en: It's running out of time to connect it.
zh: 而是来不及把电接过来。

en: A data center is just a building.
zh: 数据中心只是一栋楼。

en: Feeding it takes a whole chain: power plants,
zh: 给它供电，需要一整条链：

en: transmission lines, transformers.
zh: 发电厂、输电线、变压器。

en: And every link in that chain has a waiting line.
zh: 而这条链上的每一环，都在排队。

en: Start with power plants. In the US,
zh: 先说发电厂。在美国，

en: a new power project has to apply to connect to the grid,
zh: 新建一个发电项目，要先申请接入电网，

en: then wait its turn.
zh: 然后排队等着。

en: At the end of 2025, more than 2,000 gigawatts
zh: 到 2025 年底，排在队伍里的发电和储能项目，

en: of generation and storage were sitting in those lines.
zh: 加起来超过 2000 吉瓦。

en: For projects that finally came online in 2025,
zh: 2025 年终于建成的项目，

en: the typical wait from application
zh: 从申请到真正发电，

en: to switching on was more than five years.
zh: 中位等待时间超过 5 年。

en: And most never make it at all.
zh: 而且大多数项目根本建不成。

en: Of everything that applied between 2000 and 2020,
zh: 2000 到 2020 年申请的项目里，

en: only 13 percent was ever built.
zh: 最后真正建成的只有 13%。

en: New transmission lines in advanced
zh: 在发达经济体，

en: economies take four to eight years to build.
zh: 建一条新的输电线要 4 到 8 年。

en: Large power transformers now have lead
zh: 大型变压器的交货期已经拉长到最多 4 年，

en: times of up to four years,
zh: 价

en: and prices have jumped roughly 80 percent in five years.
zh: 格五年里涨了大约 80%。

en: Gas turbines? GE Vernova,
zh: 燃气轮机呢？

en: one of the biggest makers,
zh: 最大的制造商之一 GE Vernova 在

en: said in December 2025 that it was sold out through 2028.
zh: 2025 年 12 月说，2028 年以前的产能已经卖光了。

en: The IEA estimates that, unless these bottlenecks are fixed,
zh: 国际能源署估计，如果这些瓶颈解决不了，

en: around 20 percent of planned data
zh: 大约 20% 的在建

en: center projects could be delayed.
zh: 数据中心项目可能延期。

en: In September 2026, Morgan Stanley put a number on the gap:
zh: 2026 年 9 月，摩根士丹利算了一下缺口：

en: a shortfall of about 32 gigawatts
for US data centers through 2028.
zh: 美国数据中心大约缺 32 吉瓦的电。

en: That's roughly a third of what they need.
zh: 差不多是需求的三分之一。

en: Chips move on product cycles.
zh: 芯片按产品周期更新，

en: Power moves on permit and construction cycles,
zh: 电力却要按审批和施工的周期走，

en: and those run five years and more.
zh: 而这个周期动不动就是五年以上。

en: When something is scarce, its price tells you.
zh: 一样东西缺不缺，看价格就知道。

en: PJM runs the power grid across all or parts
zh: PJM 负责管理美国 13 个州（全部或

en: of 13 US states and Washington, D.C.
zh: 部分地区）加上华盛顿特区的电网。

en: Every year,
zh: 它每年

en: it holds an auction for future power supply.
zh: 都会拍卖未来的供电能力。

en: the price was about 29 dollars per megawatt-day.
zh: 价格大约是每兆瓦每天 29 美元。

en: For 2027 to 2028, it hit 333 dollars,
the maximum the rules allowed.
zh: 价格涨到 333 美元，碰到了规则允许的上限。

en: Analysts estimate that without the cap,
zh: 分析师估计，如果没有上限，

en: it would have been close to 530.
zh: 价格会接近 530 美元。

en: And even at that price,
zh: 而且就算开出这个价，

en: the auction still fell short of its reliability target.
zh: 拍卖还是没凑够保障供电稳定所需的量。

en: The reason? PJM's demand forecast jumped by 5,250 megawatts,
zh: 原因呢？PJM 预测的用电需求一下子多了 5250 兆瓦，

en: almost entirely because of data centers.
zh: 几乎全是因为数据中心。

en: And that cost doesn't stay with tech companies.
zh: 而这笔钱，不只是科技公司在付。

en: In Washington, D.C.,
zh: 在华盛顿特区，

en: one utility's residential customers saw bills rise
zh: 一家电力公司的居民用户从 2025 年 6 月起，

en: about 21 dollars a month starting in June 2025,
zh: 电费每月涨了约 21 美元，

en: around 10 of it from these capacity prices.
zh: 其中约 10 美元来自这类容量价格。

en: So the tech giants stopped waiting.
zh: 于是，科技巨头们不等了。

en: Microsoft signed a deal to bring back a reactor
zh: 微软签了协议，

en: at Three Mile Island, which shut down in 2019.
zh: 让三哩岛一座 2019 年就关掉的核反应堆重新启动，

en: It's now expected back online in 2027.
zh: 现在预计 2027 年恢复发电。

en: Google signed up for small nuclear reactors
zh: 谷歌向一家叫 Kairos Power

en: from a company called Kairos Power: up to 500 megawatts,
zh: 的公司订了小型核反应堆：最多 500 兆瓦，

en: with the first targeted for 2030 and the rest by 2035.
zh: 第一座目标 2030 年投运，其余的到 2035 年。

en: Notice the dates. Even the fixes run
zh: 注意这些年份。就连解决办法，

en: on the grid's clock, not the chip's.
zh: 走的也是电网的时钟，而不是芯片的时钟。

en: Others are skipping the grid entirely.
zh: 还有人干脆绕开电网。

en: One analysis counted 59 US data center projects
zh: 一份分析统计，

en: planning about 90 gigawatts of their own on-site power.
zh: 美国有 59 个数据中心项目计划自建现场发电，总共约 90 吉瓦。

en: That's more than a quarter of all planned
zh: 这超过了全美规划中数据中

en: data center capacity in the country.
zh: 心总容量的四分之一。

en: And 92 percent of those projects
zh: 而其中 92% 的项目，

en: were announced since the start of 2025.
zh: 都是 2025 年以后才宣布的。

en: But here's the catch. As of mid-2026,
zh: 但问题来了：截至 2026 年年中，

en: only about 2 gigawatts of that was actually running.
zh: 真正在运行的只有大约 2 吉瓦，

en: Roughly 2 percent.
zh: 差不多只占 2%。

en: Announcing a power plant is easy.
zh: 宣布要建电厂很容易，

en: Building one is the bottleneck.
zh: 真正建起来才是瓶颈。

en: It got strange. In December 2025, Crusoe,
zh: 事情开始变得离奇。2025 年 12 月，

en: a company that builds AI data centers,
zh: AI 数据中心建造商 Crusoe

en: ordered 29 gas turbines from Boom Supersonic,
zh: 向 Boom Supersonic 订了 29 台燃气轮机，

en: a startup best known for designing supersonic jets.
zh: 而这家公司最出名的是设计超音速客机。

en: Then, in September 2026,
zh: 结果到了 2026 年 9 月，

en: Crusoe walked away from that deal and turned
zh: Crusoe 放弃了这笔订单，

en: to established suppliers like GE Vernova.
zh: 转向 GE Vernova 这样的老牌供应商。

en: When time is the bottleneck,
zh: 当时间就是瓶颈，

en: an untested machine is a risk few can afford.
zh: 没被验证过的机器，是很少有人敢冒的险。

en: Now flip the map.
zh: 现在，把地图翻过来。

en: China generates more than twice
zh: 中国的发电量，

en: as much electricity as the United States.
zh: 是美国的两倍多。

en: In 2025 alone, it added more than 430
zh: 光是 2025 年一年，

en: gigawatts of wind and solar capacity.
zh: 中国就新增了超过 430 吉瓦的风电和光伏装机。

en: BloombergNEF expects China to add
zh: 彭博新能源财经预计，

en: more than six times as much generation
zh: 未来五年，

en: capacity as the US over the next five years.
zh: 中国新增的发电装机将是美国的六倍多。

en: One business school researcher put it simply:
zh: 一位商学院的研究者说得很直白：

en: the US has the chips and is short on power.
zh: 美国有芯片、

en: China has the power and is short on chips.
zh: 缺电；中国有电、缺芯片。

en: So electricity isn't one ceiling.
zh: 所以电不是一块天花板。

en: It's a different ceiling, depending on where you stand.
zh: 站在哪里，天花板就不一样。

en: So here's my call.
zh: 所以，我的判断是：

en: Electricity won't stop AI.
zh: 电挡不住 AI，

en: Too much money is chasing this problem for that.
zh: 追着这个问题砸的钱太多了。

en: But for the next few years,
zh: 但未来几年，

en: power will decide three things: how fast AI grows,
zh: 电会决定三件事：AI 长得多快、

en: where it gets built, and who wins.
zh: 建在哪里，以及谁会赢。

en: The winners won't just be the ones with the best models.
zh: 赢家不只是模型最好的那家，

en: They'll be the ones who locked in power early.
zh: 而是最早锁定电力的那家。

en: I'd go further: by the end of this decade,
zh: 我甚至觉得：到这个十年结束时，

en: a guaranteed grid connection may be worth
zh: 一个有保障的电网接口，

en: more than the chips you plug into it.
zh: 可能比插在上面的芯片还值钱。

en: And if I'm wrong, it'll be because the grid
zh: 如果我错了，

en: suddenly started moving at chip speed: new lines,
zh: 那一定是因为电网突然跑出了芯片的速度：新的输电线、

en: plants and transformers arriving in two or three years
zh: 电厂和变压器，两三年就能到位，

en: instead of five or more. That's the signal to watch.
zh: 而不是五年以上。这就是值得盯住的信号。

en: What does this mean for you?
zh: 这和你有什么关系？

en: If you live where data centers are booming,
zh: 如果你住在数据中心扎堆的地方，

en: part of AI's bill may already be on your electricity bill.
zh: AI 的一部分账单，可能已经算进你的电费里了。

en: And next time someone says AI is limited by chips,
zh: 下次再有人说 AI 卡在芯片上，

en: remember Microsoft's problem.
zh: 想想微软的问题：

en: The chips were there. The power wasn't.
zh: 芯片有了，电没有。

en: So which do you think runs out first: chips,
zh: 那你觉得，芯片和电，

en: or electricity? Tell me in the comments.
zh: 哪个会先不够用？评论区告诉我。
